summary:
Exhaustive Production Implementation Specification for Category 15: Construction, General Contracting & BTP (Algeria) in Atrium ERP & CRM:
- Role-Based UI Architecture across 5 distinct operational personas (Gérant, Conducteur de Travaux, Chef de Chantier, Métreur/Estimator, Comptable Chantier) with dedicated TopBar switcher and strictly isolated sidebar screens.
- Exhaustive feature-by-feature specifications covering all 5 Must features and 4 Should features:
  1. Décomptes Provisoires Engine (Décret 15-247, 5% Retenue de Garantie, Caution Bancaire, Avances Forfaitaires, 10% Penalties Cap).
  2. DQE & Sub-Lot BPU Studio (Hierarchical BOQ, unit costs, planned vs realized variance).
  3. Mobile Field Pointage & Journal de Chantier (Offline PWA, muster, weather, and activity logs).
  4. Legal OS Administrative Tracker (Arrêt, Reprise, Travaux Sup, contract clock defense).
  5. Concrete Crushing & CTC Vault (CBA 93 / Eurocode, 7d/28d compression, de-shoring lockout).
  6. Heavy Machinery Fleet & Gasoil Log (Liters/hour consumption, depot pump meter reconciliation).
  7. CACOBATPH 48h Weather Dossier Wizard (ONM bulletin pairing, Décret 97-47 statutory filing).
  8. Subcontractor Attachement & Piecework Ledger (Bordereaux, retainage, payment mandates).
  9. Site Petty Cash (Caisse de Chantier) & Art. 317 Timbre Duty (Graduated stamp tax, voucher archiving).
- Complete data models upholding Quadruple Traceability (accountId, businessId, branchId, staffId).
- Full trilingual localization matrices (French, Modern Standard Arabic RTL, English).
- Edge cases across all 9 mandatory failure categories.
- Cross-feature conflict checks, 10-point self-review, phased build slices, and Definition of Done. Zero production code written.
